name: techdella/report-mock
title: Report mock
description: Monthly report card mock (KPIs + bars) labelled "Example report", with illustrative numbers only. With a title it renders the Paid "Everything visible" section: heading and what-we-manage tiles on the left, the report on the right, on a dark grid.

note.default: Illustrative numbers only. Your report shows your live data.

attributes.title: Everything managed, *everything* visible
attributes.note: Illustrative numbers only. Your report shows your live data.

techdella.help: Never real-looking client data: keep round illustrative numbers, the "Example report" badge and the note. kpis: [{label, value, highlight}] (one highlight = dark tile). bars: [{label, value, highlight}] — widths are relative to the largest value. Leave title empty to render only the card (e.g. inside a bento or tab).
